marketRegime.title: Market Regime
marketRegime.subtitle: The current investment environment, in one read
marketRegime.emptyDetail: Needs at least one reconstructed trading day of price history.

holdingsCta.title: Add your holdings
holdingsCta.detail: Enter your current positions to see personalized Buy / Increase / Hold / Reduce / Exit actions, sized to your own portfolio. Until then, Today's Actions shows the model portfolio's suggested starting positions.

todaysActions.emptyDetail: Nothing currently clears the evidence bar for a real position.

capitalAllocation.title: Capital Allocation
capitalAllocation.description: Is this the best use of my capital available today?
capitalAllocation.sourceLive: Personalized to your holdings (live capital allocation engine call).
capitalAllocation.sourceUnavailable: Capital allocation needs a live backend — showing the model portfolio's suggested starting positions instead.
capitalAllocation.sourceModelPortfolio: No holdings entered yet — showing the model portfolio's suggested starting positions (not personalized).

queue.title: Capital Deployment Queue
queue.description: Every proposal requesting capital, ranked against every other proposal.
queue.fallbackNote: Full queue economics (priority, capital source, opportunity cost) need your real holdings — showing today's actions only.

recycling.title: Capital Recycling
recycling.description: Which released holding funded which new one.
recycling.emptyDetail: Every funded proposal was covered by idle cash alone — no holding needed to be displaced.

released.title: Capital Released Today
released.description: Every holding whose allocation shrank today, and where that capital went.
released.emptyDetail: No holding is being reduced or exited today.

bestNew.title: Best New Opportunities
bestNew.description: The highest-ranked ideas not already in the portfolio.
bestNew.emptyDetail: Nothing outside the current portfolio currently clears the evidence bar.

highestCost.title: Highest Opportunity Cost
highestCost.description: Real, evidence-backed ideas that received zero capital today, outranked by a stronger one.
highestCost.emptyDetail: Every ticker with a positive opportunity score is already funded.

allocationChanges.title: Allocation Changes
allocationChanges.description: Every ticker whose target weight differs from its current weight today.
allocationChanges.emptyDetail: Every current position matches its target weight.

cashWaiting.title: Capital Waiting For Better Opportunities
cashWaiting.description: Capital deliberately left unallocated rather than forced into a weaker idea.

portfolioSummary.title: Portfolio Summary
portfolioSummary.sourceModelPortfolio: Model portfolio (no holdings entered) — see Portfolio for your own allocation.
portfolioSummary.emptyDetail: Needs at least one reconstructed trading day and a non-empty model portfolio.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.emptyDetail: Nothing in the model portfolio currently needs attention.

committeeSummary.title: Investment Committee Summary
committeeSummary.description: Who agrees, who disagrees, and how much does it matter?
committeeSummary.emptyDetail: Needs a non-empty model portfolio with real evidence behind it.
